review.assessment: This change introduces `solution.ts` containing a bare implementation of `safeJsonParse` that calls `JSON.parse` without any try-catch block. Consequently, invalid or empty input will still cause the function to throw a `SyntaxError` rather than returning `{ ok: false, error }`. The diff completely omits the required error-handling logic to satisfy the task specification.

findings.actual: Throws SyntaxError (e.g., Unexpected token in JSON at position X)
findings.defect: `safeJsonParse` does not wrap `JSON.parse` in a try-catch block, so invalid input still throws instead of returning `{ ok: false, error }`. This directly violates the task requirement to never throw and always return the union type.
